summary: Tested Fleet feature (iteration 23) — backend GET/PUT + public /fleet page + nav integration + regression sanity. Backend 8/8 passing. Frontend: all required data-testids present and correctly count-verified (4 drivers, 5 vehicles, 4 trust notes); mobile drawer nav to /fleet works. Found 1 clear display bug: the fleet-headline duplicates the words 'your ride' because Fleet.jsx renders `{fleet.headline} your ride.` while the seeded headline already ends with 'your ride' — visible output is 'The team behind your ride your ride.'

ui_bugs.issue: Headline renders duplicate copy: seeded backend headline is 'The team behind your ride' and JSX appends a hardcoded 'your ride.' after {fleet.headline}, producing 'The team behind your ride your ride.'. Either (a) strip a trailing accent phrase from headline before rendering, (b) change seed headline to 'The team behind' so the em completes it, or (c) split headline server-side into {headline, accent} fields.

issues: Driver photos are intentionally empty; initials-only cards look acceptable but two rows of empty gold monograms may feel bare — recommend admin upload real photos soon.

action_items: Fix duplicated 'your ride your ride' in /fleet h1 — most direct fix: change the seeded headline in server.py to 'The team behind' (so the JSX your ride. completes it), OR remove the hardcoded 'your ride.' suffix from Fleet.jsx line 32 and rely purely on backend headline. Keep the fallback string aligned with whichever pattern you pick.
critical_code_review_comments: Fleet.jsx line 32 mixes dynamic {fleet.headline} with a hardcoded accent phrase — brittle. Either seed 'headline' as prefix only, or add a distinct 'headline_accent' field in the fleet doc and PUT contract.

server.py FleetUpdate accepts drivers/vehicles as List[Dict[str, Any]] with no per-item schema validation — admin can PUT malformed driver objects with missing id/name and break the /fleet page (no ids => no data-testids). Consider Pydantic Driver/Vehicle sub-models.
Public GET /api/fleet is not paginated/cached — fine for 4+5 items, but if drivers list grows add Cache-Control headers.
Fleet.jsx (~200 lines) is fine size-wise; overall code is clean.
seed_data_creation: None. Existing fleet.main seed used; PUT tests restore original values.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Fleet page /fleet is functionally complete: 8/8 backend tests pass, all data-testids present with correct counts (4 drivers d-rox/d-julien/d-marcus/d-nia, 5 vehicles v-minivan/v-suv/v-sedan/v-luxury/v-pickup, 4 trust notes). Only display bug is duplicated headline. Note admin login endpoint is POST /api/auth/login, driver manifest is /api/admin/driver/manifest.
rca of the issue: Bug: fleet-headline shows 'The team behind your ride your ride.' RCA: Fleet.jsx line 32 renders `{fleet.headline || 'The team behind'} your ride.`. The backend seed (server.py line 679) stores headline='The team behind your ride' (already includes the words the em is meant to add). So when data loads, the words are duplicated. When headline is falsy the fallback 'The team behind' works correctly. Repro: visit /fleet — inspect h1 text. Fix: change seed to 'The team behind' OR remove the hardcoded em suffix and rely fully on backend copy.
